causes.label: Too much detergent or soft water

Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.

remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.

causes.label: This is normal

This is normal for this high efficiency washer.

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.

symptoms.symptom: Movement inside machine when shut off

remedies: When the machine is manually turned off, the shifter will disengage the motor before completely shutting down.
If lid is raised before the motor is disengaged, it will resume when lid is closed.

symptoms.symptom: Short spray and delay after pushing the Start button

causes.label: Lid was opened and closed between cycle selection and start

See START-UP SEQUENCE in the Safety Instructions section.

symptoms.symptom: Washer spins and pauses at the beginning of cycles

causes.label: The Soak Option was chosen

causes.label: This is normal

causes.label: Incorrect spin cycle selected

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics
remedies: While this is not caused by the washer, you can slow the pilling process by washing garments inside out.

symptoms.symptom: Snags, holes, tears, rips or excessive wear

causes.label: Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets
remedies: Fasten snaps, hooks, buttons and zippers.
Remove loose items like pins, objects in pockets and sharp buttons.
Turn knits (which snag easily) inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets"

causes.label: Undiluted chlorine bleach
remedies: Check bleach package instructions for proper amount.
Never add undiluted bleach to wash or allow clothes to come in contact with undiluted bleach.

causes.label: Chemicals like hair bleach or dye, permanent wave solution
remedies: Rinse items that may have chemicals on them before washing.

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Avoid mixing heavy items (like work clothes) with light items (like blouses).
Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Shifter mechanism is engaging or disengaging
remedies: The drive system will engage at the start of agitate and disengage when agitate is complete.

symptoms.symptom: Back and forth “swoosh” or light “clicking” sound during agitate

remedies: This sound is the motor rotating back and forth to agitate your laundry.

causes.label: Clothing redistribution
remedies: At different periods of the agitation phase, the motor makes short agitation strokes to redistribute the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Clothing redistribution"

causes.label: Relay switch
remedies: The relay makes a click sound when activated.
The water level activates the relay and stops filling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Relay switch"

causes.label: Automatic Temperature Control Valve
remedies: This valve mixes in cold and hot water.
The “clicking” is the valve turning on and off.

causes.label: Automatic Temperature Control Valve
remedies: This valve mixes in cold and hot water.
The sound changes when the valves are turned on and off.

symptoms.symptom: Motor “whinding up” or “coasting down” in spin

causes.label: Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle
remedies: The motor will speed up incrementally during the spin cycle.
When spin is complete, it will coast until it stops.

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: The drain pump will make a humming sound when pumping out water after agitation stops and continue until spin is complete.

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged

remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.

remedies: Check the house fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.

causes.label: Gas service is off

Adjust setting to Less Dry.

remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check installation instructions for proper ducting/venting.

Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.

remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
